label: Evidence-15
title: The measurement behind '70_', fetched: W3Techs, 69.3_ of websites whose server-side language is known (23 October); HTTP Archive, PHP on 48.3_ of all crawled origins; WordPress on 39.6_ of all websites
description: The desk fetched and hashed W3Techs' language page and its yearly history, the HTTP Archive's tech report API and the other measurers (investigation php-share, 29 measures). None of it is in a vault yet, so none of it is citable as evidence: capture W3Techs' pages and the HTTP Archive counts (boards 033, 043, 222). This answers the front page's open question 'Where the 70% figure comes from' (Finding-32).

properties.excerpt: PHP is used by 69.3% of all the websites whose server-side programming language we know.
